summary.headline: Jupiter and Moon in the Signs
summary.text: Astrological judgments for Jupiter and the Moon in earthy, airy, and watery triplicities, especially their conjunction, and in Gemini, Libra, and Aquarius. The text predicts rain, winds, travel, public affairs, illness, mortality, agriculture, talismans, and the conditions of scholars, merchants, officials, women, and rulers.
